name: Oath of No Retreat
description: +1 to all rolls this fight. Broken if you Withdraw or are defeated.

name: Oath of Mercy
description: +2 to Negotiate this fight. Broken if you win by breaking them with force.

name: Oath of the Unbowed
description: +1 to all rolls, and +1 Resolve damage on a critical. Broken if your Health (or Hull) drops below half.
